title: Postdoctoral Fellow
summary: Add a short summary of the position here. You can include information about the research project, the skills and experience required, and any other relevant details.

add_paragraph: The successful candidate will design and deploy the next generation of **in-situ sensor platforms** for trace contaminant monitoring across the lab's alpine and coastal observatories. The position sits within the ==Open Science Sensor Network== project and offers unusual freedom to shape your own research direction.

We are looking for a PhD in *environmental chemistry*, *analytical chemistry* or a related field, with a strong publication record and hands-on experience with `field instrumentation`. Experience with machine-learning-assisted signal processing is welcome but not required.
You will supervise two PhD students and one technician, and there is dedicated funding for conference travel and one short international secondment per year.
Applications are reviewed **rolling until the position is filled**. For informal enquiries, {email Michael Carter|mailto:michael.carter@bioterra-lab.org} before applying.
